_note: SAMPLE DATA: well-known real papers on agents and LLMs, not today's arXiv feed.

papers.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
papers.summary: Shows that a custom interface between a language model agent and the computer greatly improves its ability to fix real GitHub issues.

papers.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
papers.summary: An LLM-powered agent that keeps learning skills in Minecraft using an automatic curriculum and a growing skill library of code.

papers.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
papers.summary: Agents with memory, reflection and planning that simulate believable daily human behaviour in a small town.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Agents improve by writing short reflections on their failures and reading them on the next attempt, without changing model weights.

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.summary: A language model learns when and how to call external tools such as a calculator or search engine through self-supervised training.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.summary: Interleaves reasoning traces with tool actions so the agent can plan, act and update its plan from what it observes.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.summary: Combines a retriever over a document index with a generator so answers are grounded in retrieved passages.
